fact: The Ministry of Education and INIC, with the Taiwanese government, reopened the Kitembu Digital centre at the National Library to give public computing courses, alongside existing centres in Trindade and Principe, to promote digital literacy.
AGER observes an absence of specific actions on digital literacy in São Tomé and Príncipe's digital policy, and lists a national digital literacy programme only as a 1-5 year recommendation.

SEGIB reports a triangular cooperation project (Portugal, Argentina, the Autonomous Government of Principe) has started for Principe island, with digital classrooms in schools and adult training centres as two of four identified projects; Principe only, not stated as delivered.
